observations: Photo 0 shows two PlayStation 4 consoles stacked on a tiled floor, one white and one black.
Both consoles are the original 'Fat' model design.
The consoles are wrapped in clear plastic film.
A hand is holding the top (white) console.
A small yellow sticker is on the white console, but the text is illegible.
No controllers, cables, games, or receipts are visible in the photo.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'SHOW GAMES' are visible on the image.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the original large form factor PS4.
No accessories are shown in photo 0.
No games or digital library are shown.
The rear of the console where warranty seals are located is not shown.
No controllers are visible in the photo.
No receipt is shown in the photo.

risks.risk: The console may have a hardware failure (e.g., Blue Light of Death).
risks.proof: Video of the console booting to the home screen.

risks.risk: The 'original pads' (controllers) may be missing, third-party, or broken.
risks.proof: Photo of the controllers showing the Sony logo and a video of them in use.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the PlayStation Network.
risks.proof: Video showing the console successfully logging into a PSN account.

risks.risk: The storage capacity is unknown (500GB vs 1TB).
risks.proof: Photo of the 'System Storage' screen in settings.

proof_requests: Photo of the controllers and cables mentioned.
Photo of the back of the console to check warranty seals and model number.
Video of the console powered on and running a game.
Photo of the UK receipt mentioned.
Photo of the system information screen showing storage capacity.
response.reason: The photo only shows the consoles wrapped in plastic. All claimed accessories, the receipt, and proof of functionality are missing. Additionally, the seller claims both 'Japan used' and a 'UK receipt', which is a contradiction.
